objective: Qualify the pinned current-source FP8 native provider, original decorated SGLang facade and fixture output-refresh contract before proposing another measurement comparison.
scope: Bounded correctness and API/cache setup; not a performance experiment or production adoption.

source.variant: FP8-only descriptor runtime port plus optional benchmark validation callback
source.source_runtime_metadata: No fabricated build metadata: official fallback0.0.0+unknown/unknown, exact source identity established through pinned exhaustive manifests.
source.sglang: Frozen research branch commit recorded by launcher; actual fixture-source hashes verified against unchanged SGLang facade and quantizer.

environment.native_build: Explicit current JitSpec build/load for GEMM and delay helper; one-time binding, installed AOT providers not used for those two modules.
environment.shared_build_cache: New unique owned directory shared by four fresh containers; separate HOME per container, no managed tuning persistence.

fixture.numerical_reference: Actual static-quantized activation/weights dequantized into FP32 matmul with TF32 disabled; rtol0.02, atol0.125; exact zero on changed-zero-input controls.

gates.name: native-facade
checks: Exact source/import/package/provider inventory and build artifacts.
Actual original decorated BMM and SGLang static FP8 facade.
One control descriptor accepted by actual native implementation at M144 and M129; same bucket256 enumeration and cache key.
Default true-miss and explicit real-memory-hit eager/graph numerics.
Original retained graphs, poisoned outputs, changed-zero/restored inputs, no profiling.
gates.selection: First native-accepted shared descriptor as functionality control; no fastest/natural-winner claim.

gates.name: callback-controls
checks: Actual current harness/tuner plus actual CUDA capture/replay and tensor writes, controlled profile durations.
Correct/wrong/no-write cases with and without callback; four unsafe-role CPU checks.
Only callback-covered no-write case must reject; preserve legacy behavior without callback.

gates.name: retained-auto
checks: Official module:factory path, one fresh process/seed19, actual cache hit and output refresh.
One exactM144 profile; runtime normalized keyM144 while runner enumeration can remain256.
gates.measurement: Two short validation rounds only, not selection/performance inference.

gates.name: synthesized-auto
checks: Official module:factory path, one fresh process/seed19, actual cache hit and output refresh.
Original nine actualMs1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,144; runtime normalized key256.
gates.measurement: Two short validation rounds only, not selection/performance inference.

limits: No claim this is stock released FlashInfer; patches remain unmerged research changes.

Native acceptance proves the native-worker control descriptor only. The two setup smokes do not observe actual selected-descriptor acceptance and may exercise fallback. Each future measured selected descriptor needs an outside-timer acceptance check.
Retained versus synthesized fixture modes change profile domain and keys; they are not an activation-values-only contrast.
BMM harness timings omit SGLang quantization, allocation and lookup; no model-serving or throughput claim.
No fresh-process persistence, scoped-cache prototype, distributed GPU, BF16, EP/MegaMoE or full-model qualification.
Do not launch objective/input performance matrix automatically from passing these gates.
